hooks.command: bash -c 'b=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" symbolic-ref -q --short HEAD); f="$HOME/metascript/.wt/${b#wt/}.md"; if [ "${b#wt/}" != "$b" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "Card of this worktree, $f:"; cat "$f"; fi; n=$(find "$HOME/metascript/.inbox/neon" -name "*.md" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); if [ "$n" != 0 ]; then echo "$n note(s) in ~/metascript/.inbox/neon/ - read them before other work"; fi; exit 0'
